overview: Anesthesiologists are physicians who keep patients safe and pain-free before, during and after surgery. They review each patient's history, choose the anesthetic, watch vital signs minute by minute and react fast when something changes. O*NET rates critical thinking at 4.62 out of 5 for this job, and monitoring at 4.12. The training is long: 69% of anesthesiologists report post-doctoral training such as residency. The pay reflects that, with a BLS May 2025 median of $391,490 across 38,760 jobs. Expect long weeks, tight deadlines and high stakes, since mistakes can have serious consequences.
pay: Pay varies widely by setting and state. The middle half of anesthesiologists earn between $207,000 and $490,530, and the top 10% earn $557,130 or more. Washington has the highest state median at $499,990, 28% above the national figure. New York has the most jobs, 7,230, with a median of $445,660.

faq.a: The BLS May 2025 median is $391,490 a year. The lowest 10% earn under $101,460, often early in their careers or in lower-paying settings, while the top 10% earn $557,130 or more. Washington, Minnesota and Ohio have the highest state medians, from $490,530 to $499,990.

faq.q: How long does it take to become an anesthesiologist?
faq.a: It takes a bachelor's degree, four years of medical school and a residency in anesthesiology. In O*NET data, 69% of anesthesiologists report post-doctoral training and 25% a doctoral degree, so plan for well over a decade of study and training after high school before practicing on your own.

O*NET rates critical thinking at 4.62 out of 5 for this job, and reading comprehension and monitoring at 4.12. Knowledge of medicine and dentistry is rated 5, biology 4.71 and psychology 4.69. Calm judgment matters most, because you watch several vital signs at once and act quickly.

Often, yes. In O*NET work context data the job ranks above 99% of U.S. jobs for long hours and above 98% for tight deadlines, and mistakes can have serious consequences. Exposure to infection is also common, so the job suits people who stay calm and focused through long, demanding cases.
